bear_case.title: Nothing is operating yet
bear_case.description: Even after Oklo's Jul 23 DOE startup authorization, zero advanced SMRs generate commercial power. Reactor Pilot Program entrants (Antares Nuclear, Valar Atomics, Aalo Atomics) hit criticality around the Jul 4 EO deadline, but those are small demonstration units, not utility-scale, grid-connected SMRs — a real speed proof point, not commercial proof. First-of-a-kind builds historically run over budget and schedule (see Vogtle); the TVA/ENTRA1 6 GW NuScale deal remains non-binding pending a PPA.

bear_case.title: Regulatory timelines remain multi-step
bear_case.description: NRC's licensing-modernization rule was formally published Jul 16 (comment period open), and Clinch River's construction permit — the furthest-along SMR application — still needs an Aug 13 mandatory hearing before issuance. Reform doesn't guarantee faster real-world builds, and slips still reprice stocks hard.

bear_case.title: Competition for the same demand
bear_case.description: Gas turbines, renewables + storage are faster to deploy for data centers; SMRs must win on 2030s economics that are unproven, even with hyperscalers now diversifying nuclear bets across Kairos, X-energy, TerraPower and Oklo.

bear_case.title: Analysts are cutting targets even as milestones clear
bear_case.description: Barclays, Goldman and Truist all trimmed price targets on OKLO and SMR in the past two weeks despite the Groves authorization and continued hyperscaler PPA flow; Oklo fell from a post-approval high near $55 to the low $40s by Jul 26 and URA slid ~3% on Jul 24 — investors are demanding proof of execution, not just regulatory wins.

catalysts.title: Oklo receives DOE startup authorization for Groves reactor
catalysts.description: Clears the way for fuel loading, startup testing and first criticality at the Texas isotope test reactor — just over 10 months from groundbreaking.

catalysts.title: Pilot-program reactors reach criticality ahead of EO deadline
catalysts.description: Antares Nuclear, Valar Atomics and Aalo Atomics reached criticality on or before the Jul 4 target set by Executive Order 14301 — the first tangible proof point for DOE's Reactor Pilot Program, though at demonstration scale.

catalysts.title: NRC formally publishes reactor-licensing overhaul
catalysts.description: "Modernizing Reactor Licensing, Safety Oversight, and Siting Practices" proposed rule published in the Federal Register (ADVANCE Act implementation); public comment period now open.

catalysts.title: Clinch River construction-permit hearing scheduled
catalysts.description: NRC set an Aug 13, 2026 mandatory hearing in Oak Ridge, TN on TVA's BWRX-300 (GEV) construction permit — the final procedural step before a first-of-its-kind permit can be issued.

catalysts.title: Holtec Nuclear files for Nasdaq IPO
catalysts.description: S-1 filed for ticker HNUC seeking an estimated ~$2.0B raise; proceeds earmarked for the SMR-300 program — latest entrant in the sector's IPO wave alongside X-energy's April listing.

catalysts.title: Sector-wide pullback despite milestones
catalysts.description: OKLO slid to the low $40s and URA fell ~3% to $39.89 even as Barclays, Goldman and Truist cut price targets across OKLO/SMR — profit-taking and execution skepticism outweighing the week's regulatory wins.
